prompt.generated_prompt_string: A Korean-editorial vertical close-up portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved face reference. Preserve her exact face, facial structure, and likeness. Capture a fleeting moment in which wind lifts her black hair across her face. Her makeup is clean and matte: softly structured brows, minimal eyeliner, low-saturation lips, and natural skin texture. Her eyes hold a steady, unbothered expression with a slight side gaze toward the camera; her lips are slightly parted, with a cool restrained confidence. Place her in a simple black garment against a neutral dark-gray background. A single narrow hard key at a 45-degree diagonal, approximately 5200K, lights only her facial planes while everything else falls into deep shadow; a very faint prism-refraction rainbow is visible only within the lit area. Sony A7R V, 85mm f/1.8, shallow depth, clean low-saturation editorial grade, controlled contrast, and subtle optical refraction.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: An approved-adult face and identity reference is required. Attach it and preserve that exact person's face, facial structure, hairline, and likeness; never substitute a celebrity or public figure. The source moodboard is optional for the windblown black hair, dark garment, hard diagonal light, and faint prism effect. The background can be replaced only with a similarly quiet neutral backdrop.
